question: Write a note on Giuseppe Mazzini.
options: Giuseppe Mazzini was an Italian revolutionary born in Genoa in 1807. Member of the Carbonari, he was exiled in 1831 and
explanation: Giuseppe Mazzini was an Italian revolutionary born in Genoa in 1807. Member of the Carbonari, he was exiled in 1831 and subsequently founded Young Italy in Marseilles and Young Europe in Berne. He believed God intended nations to be natural units of humanity, advocating for a unified Italian republic.

explanation:
